messages.content: Before we lock in Conwell, compare all four flight combinations for Philadelphia. I want the actual fare differences, what kind of ticket each is, and whether the airport timing is realistic on both ends.

The two Tuesday nonstops are 6:35 a.m.-10:48 a.m. for $219 outbound and 9:05 a.m.-1:18 p.m. for $164. The Thursday choices are 4:45 p.m.-7:20 p.m. for $199 and 8:10 p.m.-10:45 p.m. for $154. That makes the four airfare totals $418, $373, $363, and $318, depending on the pairing.
Are those basic fares, or do they include a regular carry-on?

They are standard economy fares, not basic economy. Each includes a normal overhead-bin carry-on and a personal item. The tickets are nonrefundable, but changes are allowed without a change fee; any fare increase would still be due. A checked bag would cost extra.
Walk me through the later Tuesday flight. The sponsor workshop starts at 3:30 on campus, and I may check a bag.

With the 1:18 p.m. scheduled arrival, a realistic checked-bag pickup puts you at the curb around 1:55 to 2:10. Traffic to the campus area is commonly 30 to 45 minutes but can run longer, so the likely arrival is about 2:35 to 2:55. That leaves only 35 to 55 minutes before the workshop and effectively no time to check into either hotel. A modest flight, baggage, or traffic delay could make you late.
And the 6:35 flight? I don't love the departure time, but I need enough room for something to slip.

The 10:48 a.m. arrival should put you curbside around 11:25 to 11:40 with a checked bag. Even allowing 45 to 60 minutes for the ride, you would reach the campus area around 12:10 to 12:40. That leaves nearly three hours for lunch and hotel check-in or bag drop before the workshop. It costs $55 more than the later outbound.
That makes the early flight the sensible one. Now compare the two returns against the retreat ending at 2:00 Thursday.

For the 4:45 p.m. flight, leaving promptly after the closing session and retrieving stored luggage should get you moving around 2:15 to 2:25. A 35-to-50-minute ride would put you at the airport around 2:50 to 3:15, leaving 90 to 115 minutes before departure. That is workable for a domestic flight, though a delayed closing session would narrow the margin. The 8:10 p.m. flight has ample buffer and costs $45 less, but it adds 3 hours 25 minutes at the end of the trip and gets you back to Dallas after 10:30 p.m.
Does staying downtown instead of at Conwell materially change that Thursday calculation?

Not enough to drive the flight choice. Club Quarters could add roughly 10 to 20 minutes to the airport ride in heavier afternoon traffic. Even then, the 4:45 flight remains reasonable if the session ends at 2:00 and your bag is ready. Conwell is more convenient for the retreat itself, while the downtown hotel slightly reduces the cushion for the earlier return.
Show me the four choices in total time and price, then give me your recommendation.

The combinations are: early outbound/4:45 return, $418, with the best arrival margin and the shortest overall trip; early outbound/8:10 return, $373, same safe arrival but 3 hours 25 minutes longer Thursday; later outbound/4:45 return, $363, saving $55 but creating a tight workshop arrival; later outbound/8:10 return, $318, the lowest fare but combining the riskiest arrival with the longest trip. I recommend the $418 pairing because the extra $100 over the cheapest combination protects the sponsor workshop and avoids extending Thursday evening.

Select the 6:35 Tuesday outbound and the 4:45 Thursday return. Don't book yet. Keep Conwell as the hotel candidate, but flight timing is settled before we finish checking its taxed total and cancellation deadline.

The unbooked flight selection is now the 6:35 a.m. Tuesday nonstop arriving Philadelphia at 10:48 a.m. and the 4:45 p.m. Thursday nonstop returning to Dallas at 7:20 p.m., totaling $418 in standard economy with a carry-on and personal item included. The tickets are nonrefundable with no change fee, subject to fare difference. Conwell remains the hotel candidate pending confirmation of its final taxed total, cancellation cutoff, and Thursday luggage storage; Club Quarters will be repriced only if Conwell rises by more than $75.
